components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action, e.g. 'เพิ่มคลิปใหม่'.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg class="ds-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="currentColor"><path d="M19 13h-6v6h-2v-6H5v-2h6V5h2v6h6v2z"/></svg>เพิ่มคลิปใหม่</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:10px 18px; border:1px solid var(--brand, #6d4de0); border-radius:8px; background:var(--brand, #6d4de0); color:#fff; font-weight:600; font-size:0.87rem; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 2px 8px -2px rgba(109,77,224,0.5); transition:background .15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background:var(--brand-strong, #5b3bd6); border-color:var(--brand-strong, #5b3bd6); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--brand, #6d4de0); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action, e.g. 'ยกเลิก', 'ตั้งค่าทีม'.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { padding:10px 18px; border:1px solid var(--border, #e3e8ef); border-radius:8px; background:var(--surface, #fff); color:var(--text, #1a2233); font-weight:600; font-size:0.87rem; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color .15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:var(--surface-2, #f1f4f8); border-color:var(--border-strong, #d3dae4); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Clip status pill with a colored dot, e.g. 'อัปลงไดร์ฟแล้ว'.
components.css: .ds-status-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:6px 13px; border-radius:9999px; border:1px solid transparent; background:#e2f7ef; color:#076e4c; font-weight:700; font-size:0.78rem; cursor:pointer; } .ds-dot { width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:#0e9f6e; } .ds-status-badge:hover { filter:brightness(0.97); }

components.name: Channel Tag
components.description: Which content channel a clip belongs to — color-only differentiation, no background per channel.
components.css: .ds-channel-tag { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:4px 11px; border-radius:9999px; font-size:0.76rem; font-weight:700; background:var(--surface-2, #f1f4f8); border:1px solid var(--border, #e3e8ef); } .ds-channel-js { color:var(--cyan, #0e8fa3); } .ds-channel-me { color:var(--rose, #d63369); }

components.name: Content Link Chip
components.description: Named reference link on a clip (script doc, drive folder). Opens in a new tab.
components.css: .ds-link-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; max-width:190px; padding:3px 10px 3px 8px; border-radius:9999px; background:var(--brand-soft, #efeafd); color:var(--brand-text, #5b3bd6); border:1px solid transparent; font-size:0.72rem; font-weight:700; text-decoration:none; } .ds-link-chip:hover { border-color:var(--brand, #6d4de0); }

components.name: Toggle Switch
components.description: 'อัปลง TikTok แล้ว' on/off control.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background:none; border:none; cursor:pointer; font-size:0.78rem; font-weight:600; color:var(--text-2, #5b6678); } .ds-toggle-track { position:relative; width:40px; height:22px; border-radius:9999px; background:var(--surface-3, #e9edf3); border:1px solid var(--border-strong, #d3dae4); } .ds-toggle-knob { position:absolute; top:2px; left:2px; width:16px; height:16px; border-radius:50%; background:#fff; box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.3); transition:transform .25s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-toggle[aria-pressed='true'] .ds-toggle-track { background:var(--status-done, #0e9f6e); border-color:var(--status-done, #0e9f6e); } .ds-toggle[aria-pressed='true'] .ds-toggle-knob { transform:translateX(18px); }

narrative.overview:
Clip Tracker is the shared production board a small TikTok content team keeps open all day — one tab, real-time, everyone watching the same numbers move. The system reads as a clean SaaS ops dashboard, not a marketing surface: dense information (stat cards, calendar, a sortable table), generous but not decorative surfaces, and color that is functional first — status and channel meaning before brand expression. It ships light and dark, both first-class, because the team checks this board at a desk in the morning and on a phone at night.

The rejected world is the glassmorphism/blur dashboard and the flat monochrome ops tool (à la Invest Hub, a sibling project in this workspace with a black, zero-radius, mono-numeral aesthetic) — Clip Tracker is warmer and rounder than that on purpose: it's a team-facing collaboration tool, not a solo trading terminal.
keyCharacteristics: Soft, rounded surfaces (8–16px radius) on a light neutral canvas, or a near-black canvas in dark mode
One brand accent (violet, #6d4de0), used sparingly — status and channel colors carry most of the meaning
Thai-first typography: Noto Sans Thai leads every stack, Manrope is the numeral/Latin partner
Real-time sync indicator and online badge are always visible — this is built to be watched, not just visited

rules.name: The Status-Owns-Color Rule
rules.body: Status colors (idle/filming/editing/done/uploaded) are reserved for clip status only. No other UI element borrows a status color.

rules.name: The Channel Palette Rule
rules.body: Content channels get their own four-color set (cyan, rose, warning-amber, success-green). Reusing --warning/--success hues for channel identity is intentional since channel tags live in a different visual context than toasts/status.

rules.name: The Gradient Accent Rule
rules.body: Flat color is the default everywhere except two deliberate exceptions, both 135° two-color gradients: person avatars and the single app-logo icon badge. Don't extend gradients to any other component.

rules.name: The One-Nudge Rule
rules.body: Hover states get exactly one physical response — a shadow step up or a 1px lift — never both plus a color shift.

dos: Do keep every new status, channel, or badge color inside its owning palette
Do default new numeric displays to the Manrope/tabular .num treatment
Do keep every interactive surface on the documented radius scale (8/12/16/9999px)
Do ship both light and dark values together for any new color
donts: Don't add drop shadows beyond the documented shadow-sm/md/lg scale
Don't introduce a second brand accent
Don't borrow Invest Hub's zero-radius, blur-free, mono-numeral aesthetic here
Don't treat every font-size as a violation — the working range is documented as a range, not a fixed ramp
